description.value:
Pressure Damage. You compress wind to a single point at a 15-foot radius origin within range, then release it as an outward shockwave. Creatures in the area take 6d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.

The shockwave can shatter glass, splinter unattended doors of Light Bulk or less, and disperse any cloud effect of rank 4 or lower in the area.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d8.
